name: matryoshka-centroid-sensitivity-v1
hypothesis: The pinned model supports Matryoshka prefixes. Lower-dimensional normalized prefixes can change support geometry without fitting a projection or selecting arbitrary coordinates. Compare six fixed resolutions, preserve the exact 1024-dimensional reference, and report paired policy-macro AUC, per-policy AUC and probability losses. No new encoder inference, target-derived transformation, confirmation access or automatic dimension selection.
